methodology_note: score_10 weights the 7 graded in-window events 7→1 by recency. Calc: (2.0×7 + 1.5×6 + 1.0×5 + 1.75×4 + 1.0×3 + 1.5×2 + 1.5×1) ÷ 28 × 5 = 7.59. Q1 FY27 is pending and carries no weight. The Q4 FY24 origin-trace entry (outside_window) is excluded from the weights; including its grade of 1.2 would give 7.5. Grades are 2/1/0 per v1.2. The Q4 FY26 grade rests on a single gradable promise. A repeated promise is graded once, at its first statement, and later repeats are folded into the note. Q3 FY26 call date is per the AlphaStreet header (Feb 13, 2026), consistent with the exchange recording-link filing; its page is dated Feb 17.
